cv: 3-fold stratified CV on training partition only
preprocessing: imputation and one-hot encoding fitted inside each pipeline/fold
resampling: none; class weighting used for classifiers where supported
note: Test set used only for final reporting; not used for model selection.
threshold_explorer: Uses 3-fold out-of-fold training predictions; held-out test labels are not exposed to threshold exploration.
hyperparameter_tuning: Random Forest grid search on training data only, 3-fold stratified CV, optimized for average precision.
uncertainty: Percentile bootstrap 95% intervals on held-out test metrics; conditional on this split and fitted models.
error_analysis: Random Forest false-positive and false-negative rates summarized descriptively across job, marital status, education, contact type, previous campaign outcome and age bands.
